acceptanceCriteria.founderCheck: Try to make this happen on purpose: show one patient's information to another patient. It should not be possible.
acceptanceCriteria.howToCheck: Deliberately attempt it — as a user and through any background process or connected service. Expected: it is blocked, nothing is changed or shared, and the attempt is recorded as evidence.
acceptanceCriteria.statement: When any user or process attempts to show one patient's information to another patient, the system shall prevent it.

acceptanceCriteria.founderCheck: Try to make this happen on purpose: change anything in the clinic's practice management system. It should not be possible.
acceptanceCriteria.howToCheck: Deliberately attempt it — as a user and through any background process or connected service. Expected: it is blocked, nothing is changed or shared, and the attempt is recorded as evidence.
acceptanceCriteria.statement: When any user or process attempts to change anything in the clinic's practice management system, the system shall prevent it.

acceptanceCriteria.founderCheck: Try to make this happen on purpose: use real people's sensitive information before a qualified security and privacy review is done (use made-up test data until then). It should not be possible.
acceptanceCriteria.howToCheck: Deliberately attempt it — as a user and through any background process or connected service. Expected: it is blocked, nothing is changed or shared, and the attempt is recorded as evidence.
acceptanceCriteria.statement: When any user or process attempts to use real people's sensitive information before a qualified security and privacy review is done (use made-up test data until then), the system shall prevent it.

acceptanceCriteria.founderCheck: Check for yourself: Ten pilot patients use it for four weeks.
acceptanceCriteria.howToCheck: Record the observed result against this statement: what was measured, by whom, and when.
acceptanceCriteria.statement: When the first version is evaluated, the product owner shall be able to observe that: Ten pilot patients use it for four weeks.

acceptanceCriteria.founderCheck: Check for yourself: The partner clinic confirms the plans shown match their system.
acceptanceCriteria.howToCheck: Record the observed result against this statement: what was measured, by whom, and when.
acceptanceCriteria.statement: When the first version is evaluated, the product owner shall be able to observe that: The partner clinic confirms the plans shown match their system.

coreWorkflow.text: Patient signs in with an invite from the clinic
Patient sees today's exercises with instructions
Physio changes the plan in the clinic's system and the patient sees the update

intent.desiredOutcome: Patients follow their plan correctly between appointments and stop relying on paper handouts
intent.integrationFailureBehaviour: Keep working with what is already saved and catch up when the service is back.

integrations.text: The clinic's practice management system — the source of each patient's exercise plan

intent.jobToBeDone: Know exactly which exercises to do at home and how often, and see changes their physio makes without waiting for the next appointment

mustNot.text: Show one patient's information to another patient
Change anything in the clinic's practice management system
Use real people's sensitive information before a qualified security and privacy review is done (use made-up test data until then)

outOfScope.text: Diagnosis, medical advice or symptom checking
Any clinic other than the one partner clinic

successCriteria.text: Ten pilot patients use it for four weeks
The partner clinic confirms the plans shown match their system

intent.targetUser: Patients of one partner physiotherapy clinic who have a home exercise plan
